Chapter 6150: Eradicate Enigma Dynasty

Chapter 6150: Eradicate Enigma Dynasty

“Merciful Buddhism.” Buddhist particles appeared and illuminated the night. When they touched the ground, they turned it into a land of peace infused with Buddhism.

Another massive figure appeared inside Immortal Suppression - a gigantic Buddha with numerous hands holding different things. One held a paradise, another a nine-floor pagoda, and a third holding a vajra scepter…

The Buddha seemed to be made from gold. Knocking any part of his body would result in a metallic clang.

“Diamond Physique!” Many ancestors recognized this being.

“Diamond Emperor, he has the strongest defense originating from an ancient temple.” A lord murmured.

“Only a select few can break it.” A desolate god who had seen him before said with admiration.

He was an emperor with ten dao fruits. Of course, this was not considered exceptional in Immortal Suppression Dynasty.

However, his fame surpassed Yin-eye Emperor because of his Indestructible Diamond Physique. It could block attacks from an apex emperor despite the insurmountable gap in cultivation.

“Raa!” A tiger roar suddenly swept through Sin.

A bestial aura took over and terrorized everyone. They felt like a flood of beasts was incoming, capable of flattening mountains and crushing them.

They looked up and saw a white tiger. On top of the beast was a man but he wasn’t noticeable compared to his mount. The tiger contained the power of beasts and birds, serving as their ruler.

Strangely enough, other ethereal images of white tigers were around the main one, confusing spectators.

“Six-tiger Emperor! Immortal Suppression is going all out today?” A big shot said.

Six-tiger was a demon with twelve fruits. He had six forms - seeing the white tiger was the same as seeing him.

The three emperors’ appearance startled everyone. As they marched toward Enigma, those nearby became paralyzed on the ground.

It didn’t take long before they made it to Enigma, causing them to activate their defenses. Bright barriers appeared, intending to build a strong momentum to stop them.

“Ooo-” The horn of war also echoed across Enigma.

“We’re under attack! Three emperors!” Both regular cultivators and ancestors had a terrible feeling about this.

Stronger inhabitants of the main cities could flee but the weaker ones had no chance to escape.

“It’s war.” Spectators understood the gravity of the situation.

“Enigma is in trouble again.” One cultivator said.

“Another destruction, Enigma has no chance of winning.” An ancestor said.

“Rumble!” The three emperors launched their attack on the barriers. Their auras swept through the region and destroyed mountains.

This defense was built on the grand momentum of Enigma, able to withstand most attacks. Alas, these were three top emperors.

Their combined attack broke the barrier, leaving shockwaves to run wild through the land.

“Nooo!” Numerous sects and kingdoms were obliterated; their inhabitants were reduced to ashes in the blink of an eye.
